basic_details.job_title: CUPB Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Human Genetics & Molecular Medicine at Central University of Punjab, Bathinda has advertised one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the DBT-funded project "Functional Genomics of Primary Concomitant Strabismus in the Indian Population", at Rs.37,000/- + 9% HRA. The engagement is initially for 1 year, and the essential qualification is an MSc in a life-science field with first class, plus GATE, CSIR-NET-JRF or DBT-BET. Applications go by email to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] on or before 26 November 2026, and the interaction cum interview is on 30 November

qualification.details: MSc in Genetics/Human Genetics/Zoology/Biotechnology or relevant fields of Life Sciences with first class degree from a recognized University/college. The candidate should qualify either GATE/CSIR-NET-JRF/DBT-BET.

how_to_apply: Prepare the application in the prescribed format.
Send it to the Principal Investigator (PI), Dr. Sabyasachi Senapati, at [email protected].
Make sure it is sent on or before 26/11/2026.
Keep the original documents ready, as they must be shown at the time of interaction cum interview and/or joining.

For more details, the notice gives the contact of Dr. Sabyasachi Senapati, Associate Professor, Department of Human Genetics & Molecular Medicine, Central University of Punjab, VPO Ghudda, Distt. Bathinda-151401. Email: [email protected]. Phone: 9953643083.

content_sections.heading: About Central University of Punjab
content_sections.text: Central University of Punjab, Bathinda is described on its notice letterhead as established by Act No. 25 (2009) of Parliament. This post sits in its Department of Human Genetics & Molecular Medicine, at VPO Ghudda, Distt. Bathinda-151401. The recruitment is a project recruitment on a short-term basis, for a research project funded by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: MSc in Genetics/Human Genetics/Zoology/Biotechnology or relevant fields of Life Sciences with first class degree from a recognized University/college. The candidate should qualify either GATE/CSIR-NET-JRF/DBT-BET. Prior experience in the research area of molecular genetics and functional genomics. Experience required: Nil. For discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should read the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs.37,000/- + 9% HRA for scholars selected through CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship), GATE or DBT-BET (Category-II merit list), or through a selection process of national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions. The term of engagement is initially 01 year. It may be extended based on satisfactory performance and availability of funds. The post is purely temporary, for a limited period or for the duration of the research project funded by the funding agency.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUPB Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Prepare the application in the prescribed format. Send it to the Principal Investigator (PI), Dr. Sabyasachi Senapati, at [email protected] . Make sure it is sent on or before 26/11/2026. Keep the original documents ready, as they must be shown at the time of interaction cum interview and/or joining. For more details, the notice gives the contact of Dr. Sabyasachi Senapati, Associate Professor, Department of Human Genetics & Molecular Medicine, Central University of Punjab, VPO Ghudda, Distt. Bathinda-151401. Email: [email protected] . Phone: 9953643083.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interaction cum interview, and they will be called through email. The interaction cum interview is on 30/11/2026 at the HoD Office, Department of Human Genetics & Molecular Medicine. The notice does not mention a reporting time.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow posts are there in the CUPB project?
faq.answer: The notice advertises 01 (ONE) Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the project "Functional Genomics of Primary Concomitant Strabismus in the Indian Population".

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CUPB JRF?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent on or before 26/11/2026 (26 November 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for CUPB JRF?
faq.answer: An MSc in Genetics/Human Genetics/Zoology/Biotechnology or relevant fields of Life Sciences with first class degree from a recognized University/college is required. The candidate should qualify either GATE/CSIR-NET-JRF/DBT-BET.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the CUPB JRF?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs.37,000/- + 9% HRA for scholars selected through CSIR-UGC NET, GATE or DBT-BET (Category-II merit list), or through the national level examinations named in the notice.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the CUPB JRF post?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format to the Principal Investigator by email at [email protected] on or before 26/11/2026.

faq.question: Q6. When and where is the CUPB JRF interview?
faq.answer: The interaction cum interview is on 30/11/2026 at the HoD Office, Department of Human Genetics & Molecular Medicine. Only shortlisted candidates are called through email.

faq.question: Q7. Is the CUPB JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary, for a limited period or the duration of the research project. The engagement is initially for 01 year and may be extended based on satisfactory performance and availability of funds.

faq.question: Q8. Is any experience required for the CUPB JRF post?
faq.answer: Required experience is Nil. Prior experience in the research area of molecular genetics and functional genomics is desirable.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel allowance be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no T.A/D.A. or any other allowances will be paid for attending the interaction cum interview.

faq.question: Q10. Do I need to show original documents?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants are required to show the original documents at the time of interaction cum interview and/or joining.
